title: Parliamentary committee suggests tougher copyright, labelled AI content
headline: Parliamentary committee proposes AI model access and content labelling
summary: A parliamentary committee has suggested that AI companies should provide Australia's AI regulator and cyber spy agency with early access to all new models. The plan also proposes that AI-generated material could be required to be labelled.
why_it_matters: Organisations operating AI in Australia may face new compliance mandates regarding mandatory content labelling and early regulatory access for models.

quotes.text: AI companies would need to give Australia’s AI regulator and cyber spy agency early access to all new models and AI-generated material could have to be labelled, under a plan to govern the emerging technology.
